description: Upload a file to BrewPage via URL. Max 5 MiB, video 20 MiB. Returns its primary share link and owner token. Does not expose password or TTL inputs. Returns manageUrl, a private management link (grants control; not for public sharing). Secrets allowed; likely ones are flagged in notices. Private namespace + password suit secrets. BrewPage tokens and manage links must never be in public content.

deliveryMode.description: Optional delivery choice for a fresh publication, independent of password/namespace. Fresh sites and HTML-format pages outside public (including the default unlisted namespace) always use subdomain; an explicit path there still publishes, on subdomain, with a delivery notice. Everything else in any namespace (Markdown, code/text, files, JSON, KV, public HTML) defaults to path (Promotion); public HTML may automatically choose subdomain for browser features. When creation returns an existing publication, it keeps its actual mode and URL.

namespace.description: namespace=public: listed in the public gallery and the sitemap, so Google, Bing and AI search can find and index it and people can discover it. Suits anything meant to be found or shared: docs, guides, demos, portfolios, reports, landing pages. Public pages are served right on the brewpage.app domain, which gives them the strongest reach in search; a page whose code needs its own origin (cookies, storage) gets its own subdomain automatically. Anyone can find and read a public page, so it is unsuitable for secrets, tokens or personal data. Omit (default): private. Unlisted and not indexed; anyone who has the link can still open it. Lowercase only: 1-32 of a-z, 0-9, hyphen.

ownerToken.description: Optional; the ownerToken from your first create keeps publications under one owner. Default: env BREWPAGE_OWNER_TOKEN (local server only), else a new token per create.

url.description: URL of the file to upload

name: publish_file
title: Publish file from URL
